prs.title: Handle a null custom element registry when upgrading an element
prs.author: annevk
prs.body:
An element can be adopted into another document after its upgrade reaction is enqueued and before that reaction runs. Adoption changes the element's custom element registry, possibly to null, and "upgrade an element" then set the active custom element constructor map entry to null, which the HTML element constructor did not account for.

Remove the entry instead, so that the HTML element constructor falls back to the current global object's associated Document's custom element registry. Adoption into a document with another global custom element registry still makes the upgrade fail.

Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64915
